label: Census year
coding_note: Census year of the record. This extract stacks 1900-1940; one row per person per census in which they appear.

label: Household serial number
coding_note: Unique within YEAR only. Household key is (YEAR SERIAL).

label: State (ICPSR code)
coding_note: ICPSR state code. Differs from STATEFIP; Alabama is 41 in ICPSR and 1 in FIPS.

label: State (FIPS code)
coding_note: Standard 2-digit state FIPS. Use this for GEOIDs.

label: County of residence (ICPSR code, identifiable counties only)
coding_note: ICPSR county code = 3-digit FIPS county code times 10. GEOID = STATEFIP*1000 + COUNTYICP/10. Do NOT join raw against a 5-digit GEOID. Codes are STATE-DEPENDENT and mean nothing without STATEFIP/STATEICP: ~280 distinct codes per year is the within-state county sequence, not 280 counties. The 'identifiable only' caveat in the IPUMS label does not bite here - all counties are identified in the 1850-1950 full counts, and this extract is 100% populated with no 0 codes. Boundaries are as-of-year; IPUMS imposes no uniform county system, so the same code is not necessarily the same area in 1900 and 1940.

label: Urban/rural status
coding_note: 1 = rural; 2 = urban.

label: Group quarters status
coding_note: 1 = household; 2 = additional household; 3-4 = group quarters; 5 = additional GQ. Values above 2 indicate institutional or collective living.

label: Farm status
coding_note: 1 = non-farm; 2 = farm.

label: Person number in sample unit
coding_note: Sequence within (YEAR SERIAL). Person key is (YEAR SERIAL PERNUM).

label: Mother's location in household
coding_note: PERNUM of the person's mother in the same household; 0 = mother not present.

label: Rule used to link mother
coding_note: Records which matching rule attached MOMLOC. 0 = no link.

label: Father's location in household
coding_note: PERNUM of the person's father in the same household; 0 = father not present.

label: Rule used to link father
coding_note: Records which matching rule attached POPLOC. 0 = no link.

label: Relationship to household head (general)
coding_note: 1 = head; 2 = spouse; 3 = child; 4 = child-in-law; 5 = parent; 6 = parent-in-law; 7 = sibling; 8 = sibling-in-law; 9 = grandchild; 10 = other relative; 11 = partner/friend/visitor; 12 = other non-relative; 13 = institutional inmates.

label: Relationship to household head (detailed)
coding_note: 4-digit elaboration of RELATE.

label: Sex
coding_note: 1 = male; 2 = female.

label: Age in years
coding_note: Age at the census date. 1940 was enumerated 1 April, so most respondents had not yet had their birthday that year.

label: Year of birth
coding_note: Self-reported in 1900, the only census that asked date of birth. Derived in other years. Check against 1940-AGE-1 before using as a cohort key.

label: Race (general)
coding_note: 1 = White; 2 = Black/African American; 3 = American Indian/Alaska Native; 4 = Chinese; 5 = Japanese; 6 = other Asian/Pacific Islander; 7 = other; 8-9 = two or more major races.

label: Race (detailed)
coding_note: 3-digit elaboration of RACE; 100 = White; 200 = Black.

label: Birthplace (general)
coding_note: State or country of birth. US states carry their FIPS state code (1 = Alabama, 6 = California, 36 = New York); codes above 99 are foreign countries. There is NO county of birth in any US census.

label: Birthplace (detailed)
coding_note: 5-digit elaboration, generally BPL*100. Adds territorial-era distinctions (e.g. Indian Territory vs Oklahoma), never sub-state geography.

label: School attendance
coding_note: 1 = did not attend; 2 = attended. Available 1850-1940 but the reference period changes drastically: ~12 months in 1900, ~7.5 in 1910, ~4 in 1920 (enumerated 1 January), ~6 in 1930, ~1 month in 1940. Not comparable across years untreated.

label: Highest grade of schooling (general)
coding_note: 1940 onward only. The census recorded highest grade completed; there is no years-of-schooling variable.

label: Highest grade of schooling (detailed)
coding_note: 1940 onward only. Codes are multiples of 10; divide by 10 to get the grade index. 999 = N/A. Years of schooling is CONSTRUCTED: g = HIGRADED %/% 10, then 0 if g<=3, g-3 if 4<=g<=20, 17 if 21<=g<=23.

label: Educational attainment (general)
coding_note: 1940 onward only. IPUMS recode of HIGRADE into attainment bins; different bin edges from a raw year count.

label: Educational attainment (detailed)
coding_note: 1940 onward only. Detailed elaboration of EDUC.

label: Literacy
coding_note: Ability to read and write. The census asked this 1840-1930 and dropped it afterwards, so it is absent in 1940 exactly where HIGRADE begins.

label: Employment status (general)
coding_note: 1 = employed; 2 = unemployed; 3 = not in labour force; 0 = N/A.

label: Employment status (detailed)
coding_note: 2-digit elaboration of EMPSTAT.

label: Labour force status
coding_note: 1 = not in labour force; 2 = in labour force; 0 = N/A.

label: Class of worker (general)
coding_note: 1 = self-employed; 2 = works for wages; 0 = N/A.

label: Class of worker (detailed)
coding_note: 2-digit elaboration of CLASSWKR.

label: Occupation (1950 basis)
coding_note: Occupation recoded to the 1950 classification for cross-year comparability. Manual non-farm groups: craftsmen 500-595, operatives 600-690, labourers 910-970; service 700-790 and farm 100/123/810-840 are usually kept separate. 999 = N/A.

label: Industry (1950 basis)
coding_note: Industry recoded to the 1950 classification. 0 = N/A.

label: Weeks worked last year
coding_note: 1940 onward. Reported weeks; 0 = none or N/A.

label: Hours worked last week
coding_note: 1940 onward. Reported hours; 0 = none or N/A.

label: Wage and salary income
coding_note: 1940 onward, for the prior calendar year (1939). Top-coded; 999999 = N/A.

label: Occupational income score
coding_note: Constructed score assigned to OCC1950; 0 = N/A.

label: Duncan socioeconomic index
coding_note: Constructed index assigned to OCC1950; 0 = N/A.

label: Siegel occupational prestige score
coding_note: Constructed score assigned to OCC1950. In THIS extract the decimal is already applied - values read 40.7, not 407 - whereas the 1940 full-count Parquet leaves the implied decimal in place (see its _manifest.json), so the same variable is 10x larger there. Do not mix the two without rescaling. N/A is 0, NOT 999.9: the observed maximum is 81.5.

label: Occupational earnings score (1950 basis)
coding_note: Constructed score assigned to OCC1950. In THIS extract the decimal is already applied - values read 40.7, not 407 - whereas the 1940 full-count Parquet leaves the implied decimal in place (see its _manifest.json), so the same variable is 10x larger there. Do not mix the two without rescaling. 999.9 = N/A.

label: Occupational education score (1950 basis)
coding_note: Constructed score assigned to OCC1950. In THIS extract the decimal is already applied - values read 40.7, not 407 - whereas the 1940 full-count Parquet leaves the implied decimal in place (see its _manifest.json), so the same variable is 10x larger there. Do not mix the two without rescaling. 999.9 = N/A.

label: Migration status 5 years ago (general)
coding_note: 1940 only. 1 = same house; 2 = same county/different house; 3 = different county same state; 4 = different state; 0 = N/A (under 5); 9 = unknown.

label: Migration status 5 years ago (detailed)
coding_note: 1940 only. 2-digit elaboration of MIGRATE5.

label: State or country of residence 5 years ago
coding_note: 1940 only. Residence in 1935. 990 = same state; 999 = unknown.

label: County of residence 5 years ago (ICPSR)
coding_note: 1940 only. County of residence in 1935, same FIPS-times-10 coding as COUNTYICP. 9999 = unknown or N/A. This is residence, not birthplace.

label: HISTID version
coding_note: Version of the HISTID assignment this record carries.

label: Historical unique identifier
coding_note: 36-character UUID identifying a person RECORD within a census year. Stable across IPUMS data versions, NOT shared by the same person across census years.

label: Data quality flag for AGE
coding_note: 0 = entered as written. 1 and 8 = failed edit, 2/5/7 = illegible, 3/6 = missing, 4 = allocated - so non-zero is not uniformly 'allocated'. The EXT1940USCB full-count extract does not carry these flags.

label: Data quality flag for SCHOOL and SCHLTYPE
coding_note: Flags SCHOOL and SCHLTYPE, not SCHOOL alone. 0 = original entry OR inapplicable (not in universe) - the two are NOT distinguished, so 0 does not mean 'reported'. 1 and 8 = failed edit, 2/5/7 = illegible, 3/6 = missing, 4 = allocated.

label: Historical Index Key
coding_note: 21-character identifier that IS shared by the same person across census years. This is the cross-year person key; HISTID is not. Assigned only to persons the MLP could link.

label: Links to the 1900 census
coding_note: 1 = this person has a linked record in 1900; 0 = not linked.

label: Links to the 1910 census
coding_note: 1 = this person has a linked record in 1910; 0 = not linked.

label: Links to the 1920 census
coding_note: 1 = this person has a linked record in 1920; 0 = not linked.

label: Links to the 1930 census
coding_note: 1 = this person has a linked record in 1930; 0 = not linked.

label: Links to the 1940 census
coding_note: 1 = this person has a linked record in 1940; 0 = not linked.

label: HIK version
coding_note: Version of the MLP linking that produced HIK, e.g. "2.0-2.0".
